texts:
Serve or Sit for Week 8: the lineup calls you are stuck on, from Thursday night to the coin flips.

Best call up: #BirdGang Jacoby Brissett, QB11 for me at DAL.

Best call down: #ChiefsKingdom Patrick Mahomes II, QB15 for me at DEN.

Let's get into it.

Thursday night, CAR at GB, 8:15 PM ET. Green Bay is a 3.5-point favorite with a 46.5 total, and it is down to its third-string center.

#KeepPounding Jalen Coker: 13 targets at PHI in Week 6, a full practice Wednesday and no injury designation. WR15 for me tonight, a WR2.

#GoPackGo Jordan Love: 45 throws at DET, and the pocket is the worry. QB9 for me tonight.

#KeepPounding Bryce Young: sacked 5 times and pulled in the 43-6 loss to TB. QB13 for me tonight, a borderline start; sit him for any top-10 quarterback.

#KeepPounding Chuba Hubbard: 28 carries at PHI, then 7 on 34 snaps in the blowout. The score took the carries, not the role. RB8 for me tonight.

#GoPackGo Josh Jacobs: 3 red zone carries and a TD catch in his first game back. RB12 for me tonight, borderline RB1/RB2.

Tonight's coin flip.

#GoPackGo Matthew Golden: questionable with the shoulder and foot after 12 targets at DET. WR11 for me, borderline WR1/WR2, and the lean is to play him if he is active at 6:45 PM ET.

If he sits, Christian Watson is WR9 for me.

The week favors them, starting at quarterback.

#BirdGang Jacoby Brissett: 48 throws vs DEN, named the starter again, in the week's highest total at 54.5. QB11 for me, a borderline start this week.

#RaiseHail Jayden Daniels: 300 yards and 2 TDs at SF before the bye, home vs a 2-5 Philadelphia. QB7 for me this week.

#RamsHouse Matthew Stafford: three first-half TD passes at LV. QB8 for me this week vs LAC.
#DUUUVAL Bhayshul Tuten: 63 percent of the routes and 2 TD catches vs HOU before the bye, and Jacksonville is a 10-point favorite. RB13 for me, borderline RB1/RB2 this week.

#PhinsUp Ollie Gordon II: 83 percent of the snaps and 25 carries for 103 and a TD at NYJ. RB21 for me this week, an RB2.

#Skol Jordan Mason: 64 percent of the snaps off IR, and Aaron Jones Sr. missed Wednesday. RB22 for me this week, an RB2.

#RamsHouse Blake Corum: 17 carries for 93 and a TD at LV, with 6 red zone carries. RB25 for me, a high-end RB3, a high-end flex play.

#BroncosCountry Jonah Coleman: 30 snaps off IR to RJ Harvey's 16. RB30 for me, a high-end RB3, a high-end flex play.

#DaBears Luther Burden III: 4 catches for 130 and a TD vs NE, Chicago's yardage leader two weeks running. WR20 for me this week, a WR2.

#JetUp Omar Cooper Jr.: a route on 70 percent of the dropbacks and 5 for 115 vs MIA. WR23 for me this week, a WR2.

#DawgPound KC Concepcion Jr.: targets of 1, 6 and 10 the last three games, 8 for 129 at TEN. WR24 for me this week, a WR2.

#OnePride Jameson Williams: 5 for 91 and 2 TDs vs GB. WR27 for me, a high-end WR3, a high-end flex play.
#RaiderNation Tre Tucker: targets of 5, 7 and 12, a 28 percent share vs LAR. WR28 for me, a high-end WR3, a high-end flex play at NYJ.

#DaBears Colston Loveland: targets of 5, 7 and 12, and 40 percent of them vs NE. TE5 for me this week at SEA.

#NEPats Hunter Henry: 7 catches for 71 on 7 targets at CHI. TE11 for me, a borderline start this week at MIA.

The week does not favor them.

#ChiefsKingdom Patrick Mahomes II: no TD pass on 63 throws in Weeks 6 and 7, and the game at DEN has a 40.5 total. QB15 for me, a streamer; sit him for any top-12 quarterback.

#Skol Kyler Murray: 14 of 24 for 150 vs IND. QB14 for me, a borderline start; sit him for Jacoby Brissett.

Aaron Jones Sr.: 15 snaps to Jordan Mason's 38, then no practice Wednesday. RB33 for me, a low-end RB3; sit him for Mason.

#WeAreTheKrewe Kenny Gainwell: missed Wednesday with a hip injury. RB34 for me, a low-end RB3; sit him.

Emeka Egbuka: still in the concussion protocol. WR31 for me, a low-end WR3; sit him until he clears.

#BirdGang Tyler Allgeier: 8 carries for 19 vs DEN with Jeremiyah Love back at practice. RB35 for me, a low-end RB3; sit him.

#BroncosCountry J.K. Dobbins: 14 snaps at ARI. RB36 for me, a low-end RB3; sit him.

#BoltUp Ladd McConkey: non-contact jersey Monday, still in the protocol. WR32 for me, a low-end WR3; sit him.

#DaBears Rome Odunze: 3 catches on 4 targets at ATL. WR34 for me, a low-end WR3; sit him for Luther Burden III.

#ChiefsKingdom Xavier Worthy: Kansas City ran no red zone plays at SEA. WR37 for me, a low-end flex play to a dart throw; sit him.

#BroncosCountry Jaylen Waddle: no practice Wednesday with the chest. WR41 for me; sit him.

#PhinsUp Caleb Douglas: 2 TDs on 3 targets is a box score, not a role. WR42 for me, a low-end flex play to a dart throw; sit him.

#DallasCowboys Jake Ferguson: a 4 percent target share at PHI. Outside my top 20 tight ends; sit him.

Coin flips, and what flips them.

#FlyEaglesFly Saquon Barkley: RB18 for me, an RB2, and the lean is to play him unless he misses Thursday and Friday.

#JetUp Breece Hall: RB20 for me, an RB2, and the lean is to play him unless Friday's report says questionable.

#BirdGang Jeremiyah Love: limited Wednesday, in line to play. RB24 for me, an RB2, and the lean is to play him.

#RaiseHail Stefon Diggs: Dan Quinn says he is back Thursday. WR21 for me, a WR2, and the lean is to play him.

#DallasCowboys George Pickens: limited in Wednesday's walkthrough with the shoulder and hamstring, in a game with a 54.5 total. WR13 for me, borderline WR1/WR2, and the lean is to play him unless Friday's report says questionable.

Every call with its numbers and what flips it is on the site, and Prep Notes updates the ranks Friday after the final injury report. Follow @FF_ChefHazy for every lineup call this week, and repost this for your league.

https://fantasykitchenff.com/line.html?week=8
